title: exporters/excel_exporter.py — ExcelExporter (openpyxl)
scope: ExcelExporter with export_sales_report(data: SalesReportResponse, filters: dict) → BytesIO and export_inward_report(data: InwardReportResponse, filters: dict) → BytesIO. Stateless — no DB I/O.
